@@ -0,0 +1,57 @@
+const mongoose = require('mongoose');
+
+const Request_Form = new mongoose.Schema({
+  user: {
+    type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
+    ref: 'user',
+    required: true,
+    unique: true
+  },
+
+  patient_name: {
+    type: String,
+    required: true
+  },
+
+  blood_type: {
+    type: String,
+    required: true,
+    enum: {
+      values: ['A+', 'A-', 'B+', 'B-', 'AB+', 'AB-', 'O+', 'O-'],
+      message: '{VALUE} is not a valid blood type'
+    }
+  },
+
+  unit_needed: {
+    type: Number,
+    required: true
+  },
+
+  hospital_name: {
+    type: String,
+    required: true
+  },
+
+  hospital_address: {
+    type: String,
+    required: true
+  },
+
+  date: {
+    type: Date,
+    required: true,
+  },
+
+  contact_name: {
+    type: String,
+    required: true
+  },
+
+  contact_number: {
+    type: String,
+    required: true,
+    match: [/^[0-9]{10}$/, 'Invalid contact number']
+  }
+});
+
+module.exports = mongoose.model('requestform', Request_Form);
